introHtml: Nylon school spirit apparel offers a durable, lightweight option that stands up to outdoor events and daily wear. Unlike cotton or polyester blends, nylon resists wind and water, making it ideal for game days, pep rallies, and team travel. Customize Men's and Women's Boston Flight Jackets with your school colors, logo, and mascot using screen printing or embroidery. These jackets layer easily over uniforms or casual wear, giving your group a cohesive, polished look that lasts season after season.
